title: The larger of two signed words
task: Store the larger of the signed words at first (0x800) and second (0x804) at larger (0x808), then end with B . (a branch to itself). Use only the base processor's instructions (ADD, SUB, AND, ORR, LDR, STR and B, each with a condition and with S) and immediates 0 to 255, so that the program also runs in the three processor views in the base design. The base processor has no CMP: SUBS sets the flags of first − second, and GE and LT read N and V, so they stay right when the subtraction overflows. Keep the .equ lines: the tests write the data at those addresses.
starter:
; max-word -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, ARMv7)
; Store the larger of the signed words first and second at larger.
; Hint: SUBS for the flags, then a conditional STR.
        .equ  first, 0x800      ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  second, 0x804     ; the tests write and read here
        .equ  larger, 0x808     ; the tests write and read here
